prose: Alphabet, Meta, Microsoft, Amazon and Oracle collectively hold more than $3 trillion in AI spending commitments over the coming years - including roughly $1T from Alphabet and $800B from Meta - Bloomberg reports. The article is blocked to the fetcher (HTTP 403), so the figures come from the feed's report of the piece.
highlights: Five data-center giants hold $3T+ in AI spending commitments
basis: Techmeme summary of the Bloomberg report; Bloomberg returns HTTP 403 to the fetcher
